public_answer: A sale certificate was forged before it reached me. Grant knew that, but he planned to blame me unless I refunded millions. I did not forge it. I did alter my file afterward to hide how badly my checks had failed.
question_asked: Tess Tament: Grant wanted more control over the museum or its money. What did his plan threaten to take from you?
role_interpreted_privately: Innocent; my remembered animal ELEPHANT differs from HIPPO

suspicions.reason: A family trust being rewritten tonight feels urgent and personally costly.
Losing his museum and job is a strong motive.
The permanent ownership announcement would end her restitution work; she explicitly wanted him to stop.

confusion: Nearly everyone has a serious grievance; motive alone gives me little basis to choose.
I am following the broad stories more readily than remembering all the names.
casual_reaction: The names and sharp remarks are fun. My own cover story is easy to read, and Tess's answer catches my interest because I asked her.
navigation: The answer is after two question pages. Ignore absent guests and host tracking makes the 30 listed names workable for 16 attendees.
